Today Vietlook Travel will share with you the Top Best Golf Tours in Vietnam. Let’s refer to the list below to help you have the best golf trip in Vietnam, and if you change or don’t forget to like and share so everyone knows.

List of beautiful golf courses stretching from North to South, let’s take a look

Dalat Palace Golf Course

Dalat Palace Golf Course is one of the leading golf courses in Vietnam and the oldest golf course in Dalat, designed in French style and used by King Bao Dai in the 1920s.

The golf course has a total area of ​​up to 6,500 yards with 18 holes, is 1,500 meters above sea level, has a cool climate all year round and beautiful natural scenery of hills and immense lakes.

Besides playing golf, visitors can also relax at restaurants, bars, gyms after playing golf, or can go to the health and beauty center at the golf course to enjoy relaxing treatments and professional massages…

From the golf course, visitors can enjoy the view of Xuan Huong Lake, a beautiful natural space. The golf course has a team of professionally trained staff, open space and classic design style are the highlights that bring visitors the most relaxing feeling.

It can be said that Dalat Palace Golf Course is an ideal destination for those who love sports and want to play golf in Vietnam.

  • Location: 2 Tran Nhan Tong Street, Ward 8, Da Lat City, Lam Dong.

Sky Lake Resort & Golf Club

Sky Lake Resort & Golf Club is a world-class golf course in Chuong My, Hanoi, and was designed by Korean architect, Ahn Moon Hwan, in the links style, including sand dunes and water systems, covering an area of ​​over 7000 yards with 36 holes on both courses. The course currently has two separate areas:

  • The Sky Course is 7,331 yards long and is suitable for all players. 6 players can play together to have fun while playing.
  • The Lake Course is 7,557 yards long and is reserved for special members only.

The golf course is uniquely designed and inspired by the Dien Bien Phu victory. Therefore, hole number 15 on the Sky Course is named “Dien Bien Phu”. The golf hole is also designed in the shape of Hill A1 in the most glorious battle in history.

With its beautiful location and natural landscape, Sky Lake Resort & Golf Club will bring golfers the most enjoyable experiences. The golf course is also fully equipped with amenities such as bars, restaurants, gyms, spas…

Sky Lake Resort & Golf Club is highly appreciated by experts, and is a golf course that has hosted many international golf tournaments such as:

  • The DNSE Vietnam Open 2022
  • National Club Golf Championship 2014
  • National Amateur Golf Championship 2015
  • KLPGA Winter Tour 20

If you love sports and are looking for the best golf tour in Hanoi, Sky Lake Resort & Golf Club will be a great choice for you.

  • Location: Van Son Lake Area, Chuong My, Hanoi.

Phoenix Golf Resorts

Phoenix Golf Resorts is one of the beautiful golf courses, about 38km from the center of Hanoi. Phoenix Golf Resorts is designed and built according to international standards, covering an area of ​​up to 311.7 hectares, the golf course has natural terrain in harmony with nature.

Phoenix Golf Resorts includes two 18-hole golf courses and one 9-hole golf course, the Phoenix Course, the Champion Course and the Dragon Course. The three golf courses have a total of 54 holes with sand dunes and a system of water reservoirs, creating a beautiful landscape.

Next to the golf course is a resort with 190 rooms and relaxation services such as massage rooms, banquets, swimming pools, ballrooms and sports areas.

Phoenix Golf Resorts is a golf course that regularly hosts major golf tournaments or Golf Holidays in Vietnam. It can be said that Phoenix Golf Resorts is an international-class golf course with beautiful architecture, friendly landscape and full amenities.

Phoenix Golf Resorts is a golf course that regularly hosts major golf tournaments or Golf Holidays in Vietnam. If you are a true golfer looking for an international-class golf course to experience, Phoenix Golf Resorts will be a great choice for you.

  • Location: Lam Son, Luong Son, Hoa Binh

Van Tri Golf Club

Van Tri is one of the golf clubs in Vietnam that many golfers choose. Come here and enjoy playing golf, the course is 6,700 yards long from the green tee and 7,200 yards from the champion tee, giving you the most comfortable space.

Peter Rousseau – Van Tri golf course with 18 holes offers players unique experiences, located 20km from the city center and 4km from Hanoi – Noi Bai highway, so it is very convenient for your travel.

Coming to Van Tri golf course, you will admire the beautiful natural landscape, surrounded by rows of cool green trees, giving players the most relaxing feeling.

Van Tri is a golf course reserved for club members, about 400 people. You can choose a golf tour package and the price is decided by the club, along with the club conditions to give players the most relaxing experience.

  • Location: Kim No, Dong Anh, Hanoi

Bluffs Golf

If you are planning to play golf, then you should visit Bluffs Golf. The golf course is located at The Grand Ho Tram Strip Resort, and is very close to Ho Chi Minh City. Greg Norman Golf has been honored with many awards, including:

  • Highest Rated Golf Course in Vietnam
  • Best Golf Course in Asia Pacific

The Bluffs is the perfect place for golfers to challenge themselves. The course features unique natural sand dunes that curve along the shore and challenge players.

The golf course consists of 18 holes, designed based on the natural terrain of the sand dunes right on the coast, with holes alternating between playing golf and watching the natural forest and sandbank, visitors seem to be immersed in the most relaxing nature.

Here golfers can enjoy playing golf and relaxing moments at Infinity restaurant with a diverse menu prepared by 5-star chefs, from traditional Vietnamese dishes to Asian and European dishes..

You can relax in the spacious multi-purpose room area of ​​over 150m2 with a view of the golf course and the panoramic view of the coast from above. The VIP dining area is fully equipped with luxurious amenities.

Here, the spacious locker area allows you to store your belongings while playing golf. The men’s locker area has 148 lockers and 18 bathrooms with showers. The women’s locker area has separate lockers, dressing tables and changing rooms.

  • Location: Ven Bien, Phuoc Thuan, Xuyen Moc, Ba Ria – Vung Tau

How long is a tour in Vietnam?

How long do you want your golf trip to last? It all depends on your budget, but according to the experience of golf trips from Vietlook travel, you should spend 8 days to play golf and explore the beautiful landscapes in Vietnam.

Golfing in Vietnam is growing strongly, you can join a golf tour in Vietnam that will bring you the most interesting experiences, even if it is your first time coming to Vietnam.   • Tan Son Nhat Golf Course
